messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: hosted-api queue growth detected in us-west-2-gpu-pool. Queue length > 11,800; p95 latency jumped from 550ms -> 3.2s; p99 > 9s. Autoscaler failed to add nodes (K8s error: quota exceeded). Please ack and start mitigation.

alice.ops: acked. I'm oncall. grabbing metrics/dashboard links.

alice.ops: grafana -> https://grafana.redwood.local/d/hosted/queue-overview?orgId=1&var-region=us-west-2

ben_oncall: I see backlog spike started ~2267889000 (approx 18m ago). Spike correlates with traffic from client: frank_appteam (spike token). Frank, are you running a load test? @frank_appteam

frank_appteam: not intentionally. We rolled a new feature last hour; could be legit traffic. We'll check on our side.

charlie_sre: autoscaler logs show repeated 403 from cloud quota API when requesting new GPU instances: `QuotaExceeded: GPU quotaAllRegions`.

charlie_sre: excerpt from autoscaler:
```
2026-03-15T03:02:11Z autoscaler requestScaleUp -> cloudAPI.CreateInstanceGroup failed: QuotaExceeded: requested gpus 100, available 0
2026-03-15T03:02:41Z autoscaler retry1
2026-03-15T03:03:12Z autoscaler backoff
```

alice.ops: so autoscaler healthy but blocked by cloud quota. That explains lack of scale.

ben_oncall: immediate mitigation options: 1) throttle/deny-by-client for heavy token(s); 2) route traffic to other regions with spare capacity (us-east-1); 3) fall back to smaller quantized model variant per-route; 4) evict non-critical/reserved jobs from Dedicated pools.

alice.ops: I'll run emergency rate-limit for frank_appteam token to 10 RPS and enable fallback routing for enterprise-tier -> us-east-1 while we sort quotas.

alice.ops: applying limit via rate-limiter: `POST /admin/limits {client: frank_appteam, rps: 10}`

deploy-bot: rate-limit update succeeded for client frank_appteam (policy id rl-4532).

ben_oncall: enabling per-route fallback to quantized variant `gpt-small-q4` for hosted chat route. This preserves throughput while reducing GPU memory and latency.

charlie_sre: rolling config change to router: `fallback_policy: prefer_region: us-east-1; model_fallback: gpt-small-q4`.

deploy-bot: router config deploy started (canary 10% -> 50%)

alice.ops: flipping canary to 50% now. Observing queue.

alice.ops: queue dropped from 11.8k -> 7.2k after rate-limit + canary (10m). p95 dropped to ~1.2s. p99 still high ~6s.

erin_support: heads up support — we have multiple customer threads reporting timeouts and elevated latency; tagging impacted customers and sending provisional notice.

gina_sales: got ping from enterprise account (NimbleCorp). They're seeing 5xxs. Please include them in customer notice. Priority: high.

charlie_sre: additional mitigation: enable KV/prefix caching aggressively for chat flows for the next 30m to reduce model context recompute. Patching cache TTL to 5m.

charlie_sre: cache patch applied to edge-cache service.

alice.ops: also evicting low-priority batch jobs from dedicated pools: `evict job-type:batch-low-prio` on dedicated-gpu-1..3

deploy-bot: eviction job queued; 3 low-priority batches evicted (approx 1.6k GPU-seconds freed).

alice.ops: important: autoscaler still cannot allocate new nodes until cloud quota is increased. I've opened support ticket with cloud (case #CL-Q-9981). ETA unknown.

ben_oncall: ask cloud infra to do emergency quota bump for us-west-2-GPU by +150. I'll page infra-contacts and exec.

alice.ops: paging infra lead @charlie_infra (internal) — can we emergency bump? If not possible, plan to keep fallbacks and continue routing to us-east-1.

charlie_sre: infra lead responded: cloud requires business justification; we have a 2h ticket SLA for quota escalations. They started manual review now.

frank_appteam: our devs found a misbehaving retry loop in the feature release causing duplicate requests. We're pushing a kill-switch to reduce client-side retries in next 3m.

frank_appteam: pushing rollback in 2m. Will update.

alice.ops: good — client rollback + server rate-limit + model fallback = traffic normalized. Monitoring.

alice.ops: update: rollback landed. inbound rate from frank_appteam down ~85%.

ben_oncall: queue now ~1.3k. p95 ~480ms. p99 ~1.6s. This is still above baseline but acceptable short-term.

erin_support: sending customer update template to impacted customers: short explanation, mitigations taken, ETA for full resolution (cloud quota + autoscaler fix). Will post in 10m.

gina_sales: please CC NimbleCorp and include RM contact.

alice.ops: postmortem notes I'm logging: root cause chain = client retry loop + saturated GPU pool + cloud quota prevents autoscaler -> queue growth -> p95/p99 spike. Mitigations = client rollback, emergency rate-limit, model fallback, cache TTL, evict low-prio jobs, region routing.

alice.ops: incident command handing over to ben_oncall for follow-up and postmortem writeup. My handoff: queue stable, autoscaler still failing on quota, cloud ticket CL-Q-9981 open; extract timeline + logs.

ben_oncall: taking over. I'll coordinate with infra + cloud. assigning action items: (1) verify quota increase (owner: infra), (2) autoscaler retry backoff tuning (owner: sre), (3) customer comms consolidated (owner: support), (4) postmortem doc (owner: ben_oncall).

charlie_sre: note for postmortem: add instrumentation to detect quota-limited scaling quickly and failover to cross-region routing earlier. Also add a synthetic test that simulates quota failure.

ben_oncall: acknowledged. I'll create follow-up tickets.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Severity: P2 -> downgraded to P3 at 2267892000. Reason: queue reduced and client rollback in effect. Next update in 2h or on resolution.

alice.ops: thanks team. I'll be available for follow-up questions but un-assigning active IC. Good work.

frank_appteam: sorry for the downtime on our side — will add safer retry/backoff and ramp tests. We'll sync with reliability eng next week.

ben_oncall: closing the live incident channel. Moving to follow-up doc: https://internal.redwood/doc/incidents/2267890123-postmortem
